entities.summary: Aaron Funk, mainly known artistically as Venetian Snares, is a Canadian electronic musician based in Winnipeg, Manitoba. He is widely known for innovating and popularising the breakcore genre, and is one of the most recognisable artists to be signed to Planet Mu, an experimental electronic music label. His signature style involves meticulously complex drums, eclectic use of samples, and odd time signatures, in particular, 74. Venetian Snares was a composers & musicians from Winnipeg (b. 1975-01-11, Winnipeg). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
